chunks: "Eating at the home of the people of affliction is from the practice of the people of al-Jahiliyyah, and the sunnah is to send food to them, just as the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله ordered regarding the family of Ja'far ibn Abi Talib عليه السلام when news of his death came."

key_terms.السُّنَّةُ: the normative Prophetic tradition to be followed
key_terms.الْبَعْثُ: sending or dispatching something to others
key_terms.الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ: the pre-Islamic age of ignorance and its customs
key_terms.الْمُصِيبَةِ: bereavement or affliction caused by loss
key_terms.بِالطَّعَامِ: with food, meaning meals sent to the bereaved

ai.seo_question: What is the sunnah regarding food at the home of a bereaved family in Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches the proper Islamic etiquette during bereavement. It discourages eating at the home of the bereaved as a pre-Islamic custom and establishes the sunnah of sending food to them, following the instruction of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم at the time of Ja'far ibn Abi Talib’s عليه السلام death.
